entries.name: St. Maron Lebanese Festival
entries.capsule: St. Maron Maronite Catholic Church's yearly Lebanese food, music and dabke festival in Northeast Minneapolis, held since 1990.
entries.dateRule: Set each year by St. Maron parish; recent years fell on a mid- to late-September weekend.

dates.source: Northeaster event listing
No announcement found
No announcement found

entries.whatItMarks: Lebanese culture and the parish community; Racket reports it began in 1990 to change how people saw Lebanon during wartime.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: At the church, 600-602 University Ave. NE, Minneapolis. 2026: Friday Sept. 18, 6-9 p.m. (bingo), Saturday noon-8 p.m., Sunday 11 a.m.-6 p.m., with Lebanese food, beer and wine, live music, dabke by youth and adult groups at 2 and 4 p.m., a Lebanese store and church tours. 2025: Sept. 13-14 with the Cedars Dabke Dance Group. CBS called the 2024 festival the 33rd. Volunteers span three generations and include Syrian, Jordanian, Turkish, Iraqi and Palestinian parishioners.

No announcement found

entries.whatItMarks: Hospitality and heritage of a parish founded in 1913 by Syrian and Lebanese immigrants.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: 16th annual festival, Saturday July 18, noon-10 p.m., and Sunday July 19, noon-6 p.m., 2026, at 1250 Oakdale Ave., West St. Paul, rain or shine under a big tent with free admission: Middle Eastern food and pastries, Lebanese wines, the St. George Dabke Dance Group, a Lebanese singer and band, church tours, a Saturday Vespers service, a marketplace, children's games and camel rides.
